page.overview:
What is Pikachu-colored Pichu?

The Pikachu-colored Pichu is an Event Pokémon given out at GameStop. It is a Pichu of the same color as a Pikachu, but it has no differences otherwise. It is a Shiny Pokémon, but it can only be obtained by an event. When the Pikachu-colored Pichu is brought to the Ilex Forest shrine in , the Spiky-eared Pichu will appear.
